assumptions.party: Fixed four-person; protagonist plus three companions, equal initial levels/legal ascensions, native craft weapon/leather armor/healer brooch. Early +3; Lv30+ +6. Base talents65%cap, optional legal cap. FOUR_C6_HEAL only companions C6; protagonist C0.
assumptions.combat: Public PLACE_ENTER/BOSS_ROUTE and native COMBAT actions, native enemy states, HP/XP/RNG persist across requested runs; one initial full-HP only. No food/inn midrun. Final HP report separates win/loss.
assumptions.limits: Representative declared ownership fixtures, not natural acquisition or every composition; quantities are per condition.
